leftForTheOwner: Eight stems keep American spelling, left because a stem is the question's identity and spelling is not an error of fact (the grand-1 convention): a-2a2h5d3r (aging), a-wuiz1fih (aging), a-lhp0l6zr (colors), a-krl921de (labeled), a-ezdb2l5i (popularized), a-4vhos8tt (labeled), a-lpa31bol (labeled), a-xfj7yurk (labeling). a-k60urxjh's distractors (sherry-style solera, field blends) are real but too weak to tempt; not an error, left.
